CDD_ACCEPTANCE_WRITE_STRICT.description: DEPRECATED (env 0.3.0, enforce-human-confirmation): accepted and ignored. pre-tool-use-acceptance-write.sh no longer consults it — it blocks a direct Write/Edit/MultiEdit of .cdd/acceptance-lock.json unconditionally and always allows acceptance.yml's body. The toggle carried no agent identity, so it could only block every writer (including the sanctioned transcription) or block nobody, which was its default. Retained for the deprecate-2-minors window; removal at env >= 0.5.0. See contracts/ci/ci-gate-contract.md, section 'Write-block hook discrimination axis'.
